name: Bunzl plc

corporate_actions.event: Q1 trading statement: 2025 guidance cut (underlying revenue broadly flat, margin moderately below 8%), share buyback paused after ~GBP115m of GBP200m
FY2025 results: underlying revenue +0.4%, adj. operating profit -4.3% cc, margin 7.6%
H1 2026 results: underlying +3.2%, margin 7.3%, guidance upgraded, new GBP500m buyback over 12 months

geography.fx_notes: ESTIMATE: approximate segment shares (North America ~52%, Continental Europe ~25%, UK & Ireland ~16%, Rest of World ~7%) from FY2024 segment note recollection; not re-verified against primary document in this run. Reports in GBP; USD and EUR translation dominant. EM exposure via Brazil, Mexico, Turkey (not separately disclosed). China revenue immaterial (sourcing exposure, not sales).

company_fcf.definition: Company free cash flow (after interest, tax, capex and lease payments; before acquisitions, dividends, buybacks); includes GBP71m US tariff refund inflow expected to be repaid to customers

lease.source_id: not disclosed in sources retrieved this run (IFRS 16 cash-flow lines not extracted; primary RNS/PDF blocked to automated fetch)

acquisitions.earnouts: Deferred consideration GBP213m at Jun-2026 (down GBP12m on earn-out payments)
acquisitions.notes: Eight acquisitions, committed spend GBP132m (summary of FY2025 RNS)
Net acquisition spend GBP26m; <GBP150m spent over 20 months vs typical ~GBP600m per two years; mgmt expects higher committed spend in 2026

ESTIMATE from company statement: average ~GBP300m p.a. on bolt-ons 2020-2025 (77 deals, 74 bolt-ons, ~GBP25m average); average multiple ~8x pre-synergy operating profit; recent deals 2-year ROIC 13.3% (company)

management.senior_turnover_5y: Group CEO and CFO stable; North America leadership changed in 2025 after execution problems (Morningstar)
management.succession_notes: CEO tenure >10 years; no group-level succession announced in sources reviewed
management.guidance_record: Weak: April 2025 profit warning (shares -25%, worst one-day fall in a decade) attributed largely to self-inflicted North America centralisation; guidance upgraded at H1 2026

ownership.board_independence: Standard UK Corporate Governance Code compliance (not re-verified this run)

guidance.value: Modest underlying growth plus some inflation and small acquisition benefit; modest adjusted operating profit growth

evidence: Non-food consumables (foodservice/grocery disposables, cleaning, safety, healthcare) that customers re-order continuously [S5]
Customers include Sodexo, Walmart, NHS; no single customer >5% disclosed [S5]
Underlying growth stayed near zero rather than collapsing in a deflationary 2025 [S2]
A.rationale: Consumable, repeat-purchase revenue across many sectors gives high durability, though contract losses in 2025 show retention is not automatic.

evidence: Morningstar narrow moat from cost advantage in sourcing, consolidation and delivery [S5]
2025 key customer losses and price-driven wallet-share loss in North America [S5]
Private-equity roll-ups intensifying competition in North America [S5]
B.rationale: Real but contestable cost advantage; 2025 showed pricing power is limited in deflationary periods.

evidence: Largest global non-food consumables distributor in fragmented markets [S5]
Group operating margin ~7.6% is stable but not structurally rising [S2]
Return on average operating capital 38% [S1]
C.rationale: Scale is evident in returns on operating capital but has not produced margin expansion, and North American scale proved vulnerable.

evidence: >1,300 identified acquisition targets in fragmented markets [S1]
Long-run organic ~2% per Morningstar [S5]
Own-brand expansion as margin lever [S5]
D.rationale: Runway is mainly acquisition-led consolidation; organic runway is modest.

evidence: North America roughly half of revenue (ESTIMATE) [S4]
Continental Europe, UK&I and RoW provide the rest [S1]
Some EM (Brazil, Mexico, Turkey) [S1]
E.rationale: Two-and-a-half region mix with US dominant; balanced developed-market exposure but US share likely >40%.

evidence: April 2025 profit warning, shares -25% [S3]
Management acknowledged much of the issue was self-inflicted centralisation [S3]
Recovery and guidance upgrade in H1 2026 [S1]
F.rationale: A material, self-inflicted execution miss under a long-tenured team, partly redeemed in 2026.

evidence: Bolt-ons at ~8x profit with 13.3% two-year ROIC [S1]
Buyback paused in April 2025 then restarted at GBP500m in Sept 2026 [S1][S3]
Leverage 1.8x below 2-2.5x target [S1]
G.rationale: Acquisition discipline is good; stop-start buyback timing and low recent deal flow make overall allocation average.

evidence: Widely held UK plc, single share class [S5]
No activist identified
Remuneration not reviewed
H.rationale: Standard UK governance; no specific concerns found.

evidence: Physical warehousing and delivery of consumables [S5]
Value proposition includes logistics outsourcing [S5]
Digital procurement could compress margins at the edges
I1.rationale: Physical logistics limits AI disintermediation, though procurement transparency is a modest risk.

evidence: End markets foodservice, grocery, cleaning, safety, healthcare, retail [S1]
No data-centre end market disclosed
Safety sector includes some infrastructure projects [S1]
Operating cost/sales ~22% [S1]
Large network of businesses with sales/customer-service headcount
No quantified AI programme found
I3.rationale: Moderate addressable cost base in sales admin and customer service.

evidence: Prices adjust with input costs (inflation/deflation pass-through) [S1]
Competitive discounting in deflation [S5]
Own-brand mix improves retention of savings [S5]
I4.rationale: Mixed: some savings likely competed away in tenders.

evidence: Plastics and paper ~55% of purchases; inflation/deflation flows through [S1]
Deflation in 2025 compressed margin [S2]
Inflation boosted H1 2026 margin temporarily [S1]
J.rationale: Partial pass-through with lag; low cyclicality but price-deflation sensitivity.

evidence: Cash conversion ~90% target delivered [S1]
Adjusted results exclude acquisition intangible amortisation (standard)
US tariff refund transparently stripped out [S1]
K.rationale: Generally clean with high cash conversion; standard amortisation adjustments.

ai.notes: No AI/data-centre or semiconductor end market disclosed; INFERENCE: <1% of revenue. Value null because not disclosed.

sector_specific.notes: ai_dc/semis: not disclosed, INFERENCE <1%. construction: safety sector serves construction/infrastructure but share not disclosed. acquisition_growth_pct = H1 2026 net acquisition contribution (FACT, S1); Morningstar models just under 3% p.a. long-run (S5); Morningstar states two-thirds of historic revenue growth came from acquisitions. Small-ticket consumables; gross margin ~29%; working-capital light (return on operating capital 38%).

gates.notes: G1: adjusted ND/EBITDA 1.8x (S1). G2: no restatement/qualification found. G3: no customer >15% disclosed. G4: company cash conversion ~90% (S1); standardised FCF to be computed centrally. G5: AI/DC negligible. G6: listed, no pending transaction, UK domicile. G7: UK&I ~16% of revenue and includes healthcare/cleaning, below 40% UK consumer/travel.

bull_points: North America recovery evident: underlying +4.6% in H1 2026 after 2025 missteps were reversed by re-localising pricing (S1, S5)
Balance sheet below target leverage funds GBP500m buyback plus a re-accelerating bolt-on programme at ~8x multiples (S1)
Consumables mix with ~90% cash conversion and a 30+ year progressive dividend (S1)
bear_points: 2025 showed the cost-advantage moat is contestable: key customer losses and PE-backed roll-ups in North America (S5)
Long-run organic growth only ~2%; most compounding depends on acquisitions whose multiples Morningstar says have risen ~10% a year (S5)
H1 2026 margin uplift was inflation/inventory-driven and management says largely temporary (S1)
thesis_breakers: Underlying revenue growth below 0% for two consecutive half-years again
Group adjusted operating margin below 7.0% for a full year
Bolt-on two-year ROIC falling below ~10% or average acquisition multiple rising above ~10x
